```artifact
Feature: System Availability and Backup

  Scenario: System availability should be high - 99.999% with a defined outage window of 10 mts every 2nd Sunday
    Given the system is operational
    When the current day is a 2nd Sunday
    Then the system should be available for 99.999% of the time
    And the system should be unavailable for 10 minutes

  Scenario: System data shall be backed up every night (full back-up) with a cycle of 30 days
    Given the system is operational
    When the current day is the last day of the month
    Then a full backup should be performed
    And the backup should be completed within 24 hours
    And the backup size should be as specified

  Scenario: Provision to rollback by a month
    Given the system is operational
    When a rollback request is made for the last month
    Then the system should be rolled back to the state of the backup from the last month
    And the rollback should be completed within 2 hours

  Scenario: Post back-up everyday the back-up shall be restored on a dummy production system to ensure completeness and correctness of back-up
    Given the system is operational
    When a backup is completed
    Then the backup should be restored on a dummy production system
    And the restoration should be completed within 1 hour
    And the dummy production database should be purged

  Scenario: Since the data is confidential, it will be maintained in Mangalore HQ in a fire proof cabinet 25 KM away from the Hospital
    Given the system is operational
    When the data is stored
    Then the data should be stored in a fire proof cabinet in Mangalore HQ
    And the distance between the hospital and the fire proof cabinet should be 25 KM

  Scenario: The system shall be designed to comply with health care regulations as defined by Government of India
    Given the system is operational
    When the system is used
    Then the system should comply with all health care regulations as defined by Government of India
```
